hero.title: International Business in Mauritius for Indian Students
paras: Studying **International Business in Mauritius** can help students gain knowledge of global trade, international marketing, business strategy, finance and cross-cultural management. The University of Mauritius offers undergraduate and postgraduate business programs including BSc (Hons) International Business Management and MSc International Business Management. **International Business in Mauritius** offers students the opportunity to explore business education at both bachelor's and master's levels.

overview: Explore top accredited institutions, tuition costs, eligibility, and visa procedures in Mauritius for International Business in Mauritius.

items.q: Can Indian students apply for International Business in Mauritius?
items.a: Yes, Indian students meeting the academic criteria and English proficiency requirements can apply to recognized Mauritian institutions.

items.q: What is the medium of instruction for International Business in Mauritius?
items.a: Programmes at major Mauritian universities are delivered in English, with bilingual options available at select institutions.

items.q: What are the typical tuition fees for International Business in Mauritius?
items.a: Tuition fees generally range between MUR 150,000 and MUR 350,000 per year, offering cost-effective international degree options.

items.q: Is a student visa required for Indian students?
items.a: Yes, international students require an entry permit and student visa issued by the Passport and Immigration Office of Mauritius upon receiving admission.
